notes.title: DARKEST DESCENT EARLY ACCESS RELEASE
notes.content:
[p]hello everyone! today is a very special day, because i am very proud to say that DARKEST DESCENT RELEASES IN EARLY ACCESS ON SEPTEMBER 28TH! ISNT THIS GREAT NEWS! YAY! ːsifemojiːːsifemojiːːsifemojiːːsifemojiː
[/p][h3][b]heck yeah! ive been waiting for this! how much will this experience cost?[/b][/h3][p]5 UNITED ST ATES DOLLARS. 5 USD FOR MY GAME. AND YOU GET TO KEEP IT THROUGH ALL THE UPDATES AND NEW CONTENT RELEASES!

[/p][h3][b]so what all am i gonna be able to do in your video game?[/b][/h3][p]well dear reader, there is quite a bit of content coming with this release. i wanna make a good first impression you know? 20 whole creatures, 7 bosses, 6 classes with 70 skills to choose from, and 7 full environments to run through.. as well as UP TO 8 PLAYER MULTIPLAYER

[/p][h3][b]oh my! this sounds great! but, why early access? what else is coming?[/b][/h3][p]im glad you asked, my beautiful fan. i plan on supporting this game into late 2026 with regular content drops. the early access release will contain what i would like to call "1 full floor" worth of content. theres gonna be like 5 of these total by the time im done with the game.

[/p][h3][b]cool cool. how soon are we expecting to get all this stuff?[/b][/h3][p]well, im not entirely sure. i will likely take a break after the release and spend some time fleshing out some of my ideas. after a couple weeks i will be releasing a smaller update to touch up on some of the old stuff. i want to make sure everything feels great before moving on towards adding more stuff to the game, so i will probably cycle between a month or so of having regular health updates and small content drops and a month or so of working on major updates.

well, thats all folks! if you want more regular updates make sure to join the [url="https://discord.com/invite/KJBbmSVMW5"]discord server[/url] !!! hooray!! bye for now yall, have a great day! - camphii_[/p]

notes.title: gilded access is coming soon + demo release!
notes.content:
[p]hello everyone! im pretty late with this but hey i got the demo out (like a week ago but still whos counting)! anyways, ive come to make an important announcement regarding the current state of the game, among a few other things

[b]where is my video ,game? where is my copy? why cant i buy this product right now?[/b]
things are looking pretty good so far... so good in fact that i am very pleased to say that the first major release will be very soon, like within the next month hopefully! expect something in late august/early september![/p][p][/p][p][b]i dont CARE when the game will release i want it NOW[/b][/p][p]this is just for you, my lucky yet impatient friend! theres a demo available on the steam page! play it! its good! it has a decent chunk of things to do in it, including a wicked cool multiplayer mode! the demo is a fairly accurate version of how the game will play when you finally get a full copy in your hands and if you wanna give it a shot i really hope you enjoy it!! [/p][p][/p][p][b]i played the demo, but everything was weird! lots of bugs running around![/b][/p][p]well, in this case, this announcement is coming at just the right time! the demo has actually been updated and has all the latest, most up to date matchmaking systems i can currently provide! a vast majority of multiplayer bugs have been patched up as well as a lot of general things that needed a bit of fixing or polishing were touched up! (a bit of extra content was added as well but dont tell anyone okay??)[/p][p][/p][p][b]well that covers all my concerns... NOT! theres a huge lack of "community" here, dude![/b][/p][p]fear not my friend! we have a public [url="https://discord.com/invite/KJBbmSVMW5"]discord server[/url] for anyone thats interested! please join it if you have any feedback, suggestions or want to report bugs of any kind, hell even if you just wanna be part of the community![/p][p][/p][p]anyways, thats pretty much all from me for now.. thanks for taking the time to read this and have a great day! - camphii_[/p]
